item.title: San Jose: Four-bedroom home goes for $1.8 million
item.description: A 1,533-square-foot single-family residence, built in 1962, has changed hands. The house in the 2300 block of Downing Ave. in San Jose was sold on Jan. 15 for $1,750,000, or $1,142 per square foot. This single-story house has four bedrooms and two bathrooms. The interior features a fireplace. The property is equipped with a heating system. Additionally, the house offers one parking spot. The property's lot measures 6,195 square feet.
